name: Hash Calculator
description: Compute MD5 / SHA / SM3 digests of text or files, with multiple algorithms at once.

examples.label: Digest Chinese text with SM3 and SHA-256

hints.input: The input is interpreted with the selected encoding; digests are binary and shown as hex by default.
hints.algorithms: MD5 and SHA-1 are weak hashes, suitable only for compatibility checks.

faq.q: Can a digest be reversed into the original text?
faq.a: No. Digests are one-way and only allow comparing consistency.

faq.q: How do I verify a downloaded file?
faq.a: Compute the digest of the local file and of the download with the same algorithm, then compare.
